svg.title: One message sent in three frames
svg.desc: Frame 1: FIN 0, opcode 0001 (text), payload length 11, payload "Never look ". Frame 2: FIN 0, opcode 0000 (continuation), payload length 14, payload "directly into ". Frame 3: FIN 1, opcode 0000 (continuation), payload length 7, payload "the sun". Arrows from all three frames point to the combined message: Never look directly into the sun.

g.text: Message: Never look directly into the sun
